description: The plot illustrates the "Massive Activation of baseline" by showing the maximum activation values across different layers for four distinct network components. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 24, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 200. The plot contains four lines without markers. The blue dashed line, which has an obscured label in the legend, begins at approximately 0 at layer 0, remains steady near 0 across most of the x-axis, and rises sharply from layer 22 to end at approximately 250 at layer 23. The orange dotted line, labeled "attn_residual", starts near 0 at layer 0, remains flat until layer 5, and then sharply increases to approximately 1400 at layer 6. It rises slightly to about 1480 at layer 8, remains steady until layer 13, increases to roughly 1580 at layer 14, and stays steady until layer 21 before dropping to approximately 1550 at layer 22 and plummeting to end at roughly 250 at layer 23. The green dash-dot line, labeled "ffn_output", starts near 0 at layer 0, spikes to approximately 1380 at layer 5, and drops sharply to about 40 at layer 6. It remains low until layer 12, spikes again to roughly 1000 at layer 13, drops to about 90 at layer 14, remains low until layer 21, spikes a third time to approximately 1180 at layer 22, and ends at roughly 550 at layer 23. The red solid line, labeled "ffn_residual", starts near 0 at layer 0, jumps sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, and rises to about 1480 at layer 7. It remains steady until layer 12, rises to roughly 1560 at layer 13 and 1580 at layer 14, and stays steady until layer 20. It then drops to approximately 1540 at layer 21, plummets to roughly 390 at layer 22, and rises to end at approximately 620 at layer 23.
